application_analysis_tests.reason: The three actual TE-image integration tests run separately with pinned originals in the REA workflow; all 13 wrapper tests pass there without skips.

local_analysis_tests.resolved_error: The unchanged Intel TVB emulator hit its one-second time boundary on Windows during the full suite; its isolated recheck passed. The full suite passed in cloud.

source_review.scenario_group_convention: 96 scenario functions plus the established JSON escaping check group; 97 is not a command count.
source_review.report_count_scope: 1742 newline JSON objects emitted by cli_test --emit; separate process checks are additional.

static_semantics_review.hob: Four original-instruction oracle records and fifteen malformed/read failures; complete 528-byte headers, 500-byte payloads and four ignored alignment bytes. Nonzero padding is accepted; the former 524-byte envelope and header length are rejected. Absent raw zero codes are labelled absent, low-eight masks and overlap retained, PM/APOB/physical/OS binding unverified.
static_semantics_review.hob_allocator: Original producer wrapper and the reference PEI table's allocator slot execute in one replay; 524-byte requests become 528-byte headers. IDTR, PEI/PHIT memory, register replies and HOB lookup remain synthetic. This source check is not a fresh REA/Unicorn run or proof of runtime service selection.
static_semantics_review.shaper_read: Ten reports; full signed-byte values remain readable without PBO enablement, invalid/incomplete snapshots do not publish raw/counts.
static_semantics_review.shaper_write: Seventeen reports; full table/capability snapshots, no-op, stale snapshots, out-of-range other tier, rejected/uncertain writes, partial readback and changed unselected tier. Verification is only the complete saved table, with no retry or rollback.

result.commit_binding: The selected git object and local run designation are crosschecked. Logs do not independently attest their source revision; no cryptographic binary-to-source provenance is claimed.
limits: Summary logs and frozen assertions are checked, not every emitted fixture JSON object; successful process runs do not retain those objects.
Synthetic transport fixtures and ordinary cloud CPUID/runtime smoke checks are not 9950X3D hardware validation.
No PM slot, physical CCD, APIC or OS identity binding is established by the HOB decoder.
Shaper verification covers saved offset words, not downstream acknowledgement, hidden baseline, voltage or stability.
Package archives are hashed but are not installed or unpacked by this independent review.

files.observations: Actually inspected with view_image. All five expected/readback words and Matched rows are visible. Tier 2 shows -5 / 0 / 30 and 0x1E00FB02; other saved words stay 0/1/3/4. Footer clearly limits verification to saved offsets, leaves baselines/physical anchors/MP5/electrical effects unverified, and states no automatic retry or rollback. Inputs and footer are not cropped.

Actually inspected with view_image. All sixteen rows are visible, target 0 masks 0x80/0x3F and target 1 masks 0x03/0xFC agree with the original-byte fixture. Core-bit states show enabled, not enabled, or fuse-excluded. Footer explicitly shows 528 bytes (524 requested, 4 padding) and identifies caller-supplied offline data, opaque bit-8 flags, low-8 versus low-16 masks, unknown PM/physical/APIC/OS binding, and no hardware access or edit preparation. Default selected hardware profile does not authenticate or bind this offline record. Empty Shaper placeholders truncate trailing counts text but preserve each numeric bound; result rows and footer are fully visible. No blocking clipping was observed.
